reviews.text: Excellent! Very good סרום לחות שנותן מילוי מיידי ותחושת רכות לעור. נספג טוב, לא דביק, ועוזר לשמור על לחות לאורך היום. מתאים במיוחד לעור מיובש.
reviews.zh: Excellent！一枝好正嘅保濕精華，即時有填充感同柔軟感畀皮膚。吸收得好，唔會黏笠，可以幫手維持全日保濕。特別適合乾性肌。

reviews.text: The serum has a thick texture. It is absorbed quickly enough. The slightly sticky layer will not remain on the face for long. The smell is not very pleasant. But the skin is soft after it.
reviews.zh: 精華質地厚。吸收得夠快。少少黏笠嘅感覺唔會喺塊面留得太耐。味道唔算好聞。但用完之後皮膚好軟。

reviews.text: It absorbs quickly, and you can see a noticeable effect on your face the next day—your skin feels moisturized with a slight tight effect.
reviews.zh: 吸收得快，聽日就睇得到塊面有明顯效果——皮膚感覺保濕，有少少緊緻效果。

reviews.text: I read a lot of positive comments about this serum so decided to give it a try. It absorbs quick and no irritation to my sensitive skin. Moisturising is ok.
reviews.zh: 睇咗好多關於呢款精華嘅好評，所以決定試下。吸收得快，對我嘅敏感肌冇刺激。保濕OK。

reviews.text: My skin really likes Cosrx products. This one is no exception. I will repurchase.I have sensitive skin and this did not irriate at all and I was new to using Hyaluronic Acid.
reviews.zh: 我塊皮膚真係好啱 Cosrx 嘅產品。呢款亦唔例外。會回購。我係敏感肌，呢款完全冇刺激到我，而且我係第一次用 Hyaluronic Acid。

reviews.text: The first time I bought this serum I thought it sisnt do much, but after I finished the bottlw ans had to go without, I realized how much this product was doing for my skin. It keeps my skin moisturized and plump without breaking me out. Now im on my fourth bottle!
reviews.zh: 第一次買呢款精華嘅時候覺得佢冇咩效果，但用完支之後冇得用，我先意識到呢款產品對我塊皮膚有幾大幫助。佢可以保持皮膚保濕同飽滿，又唔會令我爆瘡。而家已經用緊第四支！

reviews.text: I held off on writing this as I initially wasn’t impressed with this serum. After a few weeks of use though, I’ve grown to really love it! It’s not greasy, it goes on very light which I think is great for layered products. My skin is sensitive and I have had no issues with this causing irritation. I will be reordering this one!
reviews.zh: 一開始我冇即刻寫評價，因為初頭對呢款精華冇咩感覺。但用咗幾個禮拜之後，我越嚟越鍾意！佢唔油笠，搽上去好輕，我覺得對疊加護膚品嚟講好正。我係敏感肌，用咗完全冇刺激嘅問題。一定會再回購呢款！

reviews.text:
I recently tried COSRX The Hyaluronic Acid 3 Serum, and I have to say, I was really impressed with the results. The serum comes in a small, simple bottle with a dropper for easy application. The serum itself is a clear, lightweight texture that feels hydrating and refreshing on the skin.
The first thing I noticed about this serum is how quickly it absorbed into my skin. It didn't leave any sticky or oily residue, and it felt really lightweight and breathable on the skin. It contains three different molecular sizes of hyaluronic acid that work together to deeply hydrate the skin.
After using this serum I noticed a visible improvement in the overall hydration and plumpness of my skin. It felt smoother, more supple, and deeply moisturized. I also appreciate that this serum is free from harmful chemicals like parabens, artificial fragrances, and sulfates. It's suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
reviews.zh:
我最近試咗 COSRX The Hyaluronic Acid 3 Serum，必須話，我對個效果真係好驚喜。支精華用細小、簡單嘅瓶子裝，配返滴管，方便塗抹。精華本身係透明、質地輕盈，搽上面有保濕同清爽嘅感覺。
我首先留意到嘅係，支精華好快就俾皮膚吸收晒。佢唔會留低任何黏笠或者油膩嘅殘留物，感覺真係好輕身透氣，皮膚零負擔。佢含有三種唔同分子大小嘅玻尿酸，一齊發揮作用，為皮膚深層保濕。
用完呢支精華之後，我見到皮膚整體嘅水潤度同飽滿度有明顯改善。摸落更滑、更柔軟，深層保濕嘅感覺好明顯。我亦都好鍾意呢支精華唔含 parabens、人工香料、sulfates 呢啲有害化學物，所有膚質都適合，敏感肌都用得。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
